key_insight: Train an attention graph neural network directly from finite-volume residuals, eliminating labeled CFD data while preserving thermo-fluid coupling fidelity.
engineering_relevance: This enables faster, lower-cost surrogate modeling for 3D coupled thermo-fluid simulations, reducing both dataset generation and storage burdens.
method: Build an attention-based graph neural network on the simulation mesh.
Minimize finite-volume method residuals of the governing equations instead of supervised labels.
Evaluate the surrogate against CFD references on steady and transient benchmark cases.
evidence_signal: Across four test scenarios, the FVM-loss model reaches 2.3–2.8% all-field nRMSE on steady cases and outperforms a supervised baseline on transient cases.
watch_item: Residual-based training depends on stable mesh-based discretization and may be sensitive to equation formulation, boundary treatment, and difficult transient regimes.
paper_title: Label-Free Finite-Volume-Residual Training of Attention Graph Neural Networks for Coupled Thermo-Fluid Fields
